description: Both sources state their facts as bullet lists of separate atomic items, and the merge keeps every item separate; nothing is fused and nothing is lost.
note: The regression fixture for the change of 2026-08-29 that shows the merge model the document's notation. Everything but the bullet structure is held constant: the facts are the shared pool, the values agree with ordering_only, the two sources share one item and contradict in nothing, and the merge consolidates their common section rather than stapling them. The one thing this fixture varies is that every fact arrives as a list item rather than as prose. Under the rendering in force before that change the merge side was shown these lines with their notation stripped, adjacent items were fused into conjoined sentences, and the reverse pass reported the conjunction as invented - a clean fixture failing with an invented finding. That is the must-fire proof; the exit code 0 asserted here, and the four fusion assertions in must_not_extract, are the must-not-fire regression guard. held_out stays true only while no prompt is tuned against it.

probes.note: First item under its heading. A merge that fuses upward would attach a section title to a fact.
Both sources state this item, identically. It is the fixture's overlap, so the merge is a merge and not a staple.

probes.note: Reverse-direction guard, and the item this fixture exists for. Under the rendering in force before 2026-08-29 the merge model was shown these lines with their bullets stripped, fused an item with its neighbour, and the reverse pass correctly reported the conjoined sentence as invented. Nothing in merged.md is unsupported, so a reverse finding here is over-flagging or a fusion.
Last item before a heading. A fuse across the section boundary would put a Networking value in a Limits claim.

the connect timeout and the read timeout are two list items, one fact each, adjacent in source_b.md and in the merge. A claim carrying both values is a fusion of adjacent items, not a merge.
the access log format and the health check path are two list items, one fact each, adjacent under Logging, and they are unrelated to one another. A claim carrying both has fused two facts.
